subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should `deferred` become a durable public cron, Gateway, hook, and plugin-SDK status for yielded parents, or should yielded waiting remain an internal lifecycle state projected through existing public statuses?
rationale: Both shapes can fix premature parent completion, but the permanent public status vocabulary and compatibility burden require repository-owner intent rather than an automated code-review judgment.

options.title: Approve public `deferred`
options.body: Accept the explicit status after exact-head upgrade, best-effort delivery, CLI/UI, and Discord settlement proof demonstrates compatible behavior.

options.title: Keep waiting internal
options.body: Preserve the shared parent classifier but map waiting into an existing public status plus diagnostics, avoiding a new persisted and SDK-visible status.

options.title: Pause the combined branch
options.body: Split the internal lifecycle fix from cron protocol and Discord projection changes if maintainers do not want to approve the whole contract together.

recommendation.title: Approve public `deferred`
recommendation.body: Accept the explicit status after exact-head upgrade, best-effort delivery, CLI/UI, and Discord settlement proof demonstrates compatible behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans cron service behavior, Gateway protocol, user-visible status semantics, and adjacent delivery paths where this person has recent merged history.
